KX-LOCAL-CFT.name: Local reciprocity and local existence theorem
KX-LOCAL-CFT.reference: J. S. Milne, Class Field Theory, Chapter I, Theorems 1.1 and 1.4; profinite completion and units/inertia in paragraphs 1.10-1.11.
KX-LOCAL-CFT.precise_input: The topological abelianization of the absolute Galois group of a finite extension K/Q_ell is the profinite completion of K^times, and units correspond to inertia.
KX-LOCAL-CFT.hypothesis_match: K is the completion at the original valuation; source splitting identifies it with F_v. Arithmetic Frobenius normalization is fixed; free/torsion decomposition is proved separately.

KX-CHENEVIER.name: Continuous determinant prorepresentability under Phi_ell
KX-CHENEVIER.reference: G. Chenevier, arXiv:0809.0415v2, Propositions 3.3 and 3.7 and Remark 3.5.
KX-CHENEVIER.precise_input: Continuous determinants deforming a finite-field semisimple residual representation of a profinite group satisfying condition (F) have a complete Noetherian local universal W(k)-algebra.
KX-CHENEVIER.hypothesis_match: GDet is a multiplicative homogeneous polynomial law with full naturality. Condition (F) is exact PhiCond. The residual direct sum is finite and continuous. No residual irreducibility or ell>n assumption is introduced. Actual O extension and degree zero are proved separately.
